name: Wireless Peripheral Battery
author: gexavi
description: Battery levels of wireless Logitech (HID++) devices and headsets, SteelSeries Arctis and HyperX headsets, Bluetooth headphones known to UPower, and any device battery the kernel reports (game controllers, Corsair Void, Apple Magic devices…), read by a small sandboxed system service. No Solaar or headsetcontrol needed.

barWidget.description: Mouse, keyboard, headset and controller battery percentages. Hover for details. Requires the bundled service: sudo service/install.sh
